sources.attribution: CC BY 4.0 ign.es. Corridor geometry derived from Información Geográfica de Referencia de Redes de Transporte, service snapshot 24/10/2026.
sources.changes: Selected road links were ordered, rounded to 0.1 metres and translated to local coordinates. Junctions use shared source node IDs. Fictitious source links retain their flag.
sources.date: 2026-10-24 service snapshot; per-link lifespan dates retained in the input
sources.name: IGN · IGR Redes de Transporte · RoadLink

sources.attribution: CC BY 4.0 ign.es. Elevation profile derived from MDT05, service snapshot 24/10/2026.
sources.changes: The 5 metre ground grid was sampled every 10 metres along the route. Values describe terrain, including beneath bridges, and are not road-deck heights.
sources.name: IGN · Modelo Digital del Terreno · MDT05

sources.attribution: CC BY 4.0 scne.es. Lake outline traced from PNOA orthophotography, service snapshot 24/10/2026.
sources.changes: The Casa de Campo lake shoreline was traced by eye from the orthophoto as a 208-point outline in local metres. No imagery is included.
sources.name: IGN · PNOA orthophoto

sources.attribution: Microsoft Global ML Building Footprints, release 2026-08-13, Spain tile 033111012.
sources.changes: Footprints were clipped to the corridor, simplified and rounded. Available Microsoft heights are machine estimates. Missing heights remain unavailable.
sources.name: Microsoft · Global ML Building Footprints
